students.name: Test Student 1
students.subject: SAT Math
coverNextSession: Holt-A1 §1-5: Solving Equations with Variables on Both Sides
Holt-A1 §4-3: Rate of Change and Slope
strengths: Solves Two-Step and Multi-Step Equations (Holt-A1 §1-4) reliably, distributing before combining like terms.
Reads Rate of Change and Slope (Holt-A1 §4-3) correctly off a table of values.
weaknesses: Drops the sign when collecting variable terms in Solving Equations with Variables on Both Sides (Holt-A1 §1-5).
Cannot yet isolate the target variable in Solving for a Variable (Holt-A1 §1-6) when it sits in a denominator.
Swaps x- and y-intercepts in Using Intercepts (Holt-A1 §4-2).

students.name: Test Student 2
students.subject: Pre-Calculus
coverNextSession: Foerster-AT §8-3: Radicals, and Simple Radical Form
Foerster-AT §8-5: Variation Functions with Non-Integer Exponents
strengths: Checks excluded values before writing the solution set in Fractional Equations and Extraneous Solutions (Foerster-AT §7-10).
Locates vertical asymptotes from the denominator's zeros in Graphs of Rational Algebraic Functions, again (Foerster-AT §7-9).
weaknesses: Long Division of Polynomials (Foerster-AT §7-5) breaks down when a degree is missing and a zero placeholder is needed.
Leaves radicals in the denominator instead of reducing to Simple Radical Form (Foerster-AT §8-3).
